editing.scope: Literal text replacement on an exported document; no checkpoint write or product transaction is implied.
editing.timing_overlap: Included in method and open-process wall time; do not add these timers.

validation_after.timing_overlap: Included in method and open-process wall time.
validation_after.validator: Existing Rust schema checker called by trial tooling on the actual external file; not a CLI commit.

validation_before.timing_overlap: Included in method and open-process wall time.
validation_before.validator: Existing Rust schema checker called by trial tooling on the actual external file; not a CLI commit.

interaction.response_scope: Includes launcher rejection events without an input command.
interaction.timing_overlap: Receiver durations include their nested process time; do not add the two columns.

phase_note: Phase counters use retained wire records; intermediate process timers are incomplete until close. External edit/validation costs are separate, not zero.

shared_controls.response_scope: Includes launcher rejection events without an input command.
shared_controls.timing_overlap: Receiver durations include their nested process time; do not add the two columns.
